+from typing import List, Tuple
+
+class Snake:
+    """Snake model for grid-based movement.
+
+    body: list of (x,y) tuples. Head is body[-1].
+    dir: (dx,dy) current movement direction.
+    grow: bool flag; when True, next move will increase length by 1.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, start_positions: List[Tuple[int, int]], start_dir: Tuple[int, int]) -> None:
+        self.body = list(start_positions)
+        self.dir = start_dir
+        self.grow = False
+
+    def head(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+        return self.body[-1]
+
+    def move(self) -> None:
+        """Advance the snake by one cell in the current direction.
+        If grow is True, extend without removing tail once.
+        """
+        hx, hy = self.head()
+        dx, dy = self.dir
+        new_head = (hx + dx, hy + dy)
+        if self.grow:
+            # keep tail, just append new head
+            self.body.append(new_head)
+            self.grow = False
+        else:
+            # move forward: drop tail, append head
+            self.body.pop(0)
+            self.body.append(new_head)
+
+    def change_direction(self, new_dir: Tuple[int, int]) -> bool:
+        """Change direction if new_dir is not the precise opposite of current.
+        Returns True if direction changed, False otherwise.
+        """
+        ndx, ndy = new_dir
+        cdx, cdy = self.dir
+        # prevent reversing directly into itself
+        if (ndx == -cdx and ndy == -cdy) or (ndx == cdx and ndy == cdy):
+            return False
+        self.dir = (ndx, ndy)
+        return True
+
+    def grow_by_one(self) -> None:
+        self.grow = True
+
+    def collides_with_self(self) -> bool:
+        """Return True if head collides with any other body segment."""
+        head = self.head()
+        return head in self.body[:-1]
+
+    def collides_with_wall(self, grid_w: int, grid_h: int) -> bool:
+        hx, hy = self.head()
+        return not (0 <= hx < grid_w and 0 <= hy < grid_h)

+import sys
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import random
+import pygame
+from typing import Set, Tuple
+
+# Ensure package imports work when running as script or module
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+from game.constants import (
+    GRID_SIZE,
+    CELL_SIZE,
+    HUD_HEIGHT,
+    WIDTH,
+    HEIGHT,
+    FPS,
+    COLOR_BG,
+    COLOR_GRID,
+    COLOR_SNAKE,
+    COLOR_FOOD,
+    COLOR_HUD_TEXT,
+    COLOR_GAME_OVER,
+    DIRECTIONS,
+)
+from game.snake import Snake
+from game.food import Food
+
+
+def grid_to_pixels(pos: Tuple[int, int]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+    """Convert grid coordinate (x,y) to pixel top-left position inside window.
+
+    Pixel Y includes HUD_HEIGHT offset.
+    """
+    x, y = pos
+    return x * CELL_SIZE, HUD_HEIGHT + y * CELL_SIZE
+
+
+class Game:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        pygame.init()
+        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
+        pygame.display.set_caption("Snake")
+        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
+        self.font_score = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
+        self.font_controls = pygame.font.Font(None, 24)
+
+        self.running = True
+        self.new_game()
+
+    def new_game(self) -> None:
+        """Initialize or reset the game state."""
+        mid_x = GRID_SIZE // 2
+        mid_y = GRID_SIZE // 2
+        # 3-length snake centered horizontally, head at the rightmost segment, moving right
+        start_positions = [(mid_x - 1, mid_y), (mid_x, mid_y), (mid_x + 1, mid_y)]
+        start_dir = DIRECTIONS['RIGHT']
+        self.snake = Snake(start_positions, start_dir)
+        self.food = Food(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE)
+        # ensure food not on snake
+        exclude = set(self.snake.body)
+        self.food.spawn(exclude)
+        self.score = 0
+        self.game_over = False
+        print("RESTART", flush=True)
+
+    def handle_key(self, key) -> None:
+        if key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
+            print("QUIT", flush=True)
+            self.running = False
+            return
+        if key == pygame.K_r:
+            self.new_game()
+            return
+        if self.game_over:
+            # ignore direction changes while game over
+            return
+        # Arrow keys
+        mapping = {
+            pygame.K_UP: 'UP',
+            pygame.K_DOWN: 'DOWN',
+            pygame.K_LEFT: 'LEFT',
+            pygame.K_RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
+        }
+        if key in mapping:
+            name = mapping[key]
+            new_dir = DIRECTIONS[name]
+            changed = self.snake.change_direction(new_dir)
+            if changed:
+                print(f"DIRECTION {name}", flush=True)
+
+    def update(self) -> None:
+        if self.game_over:
+            return
+        # Move snake one cell per frame (FPS controls speed)
+        self.snake.move()
+        # Check collisions
+        if self.snake.collides_with_wall(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE) or self.snake.collides_with_self():
+            self.game_over = True
+            print("GAME OVER", flush=True)
+            return
+        # Check eating
+        if self.snake.head() == self.food.get_pos():
+            self.snake.grow_by_one()
+            self.score += 1
+            print(f"SCORE:{self.score}", flush=True)
+            # spawn new food excluding snake body
+            exclude: Set[Tuple[int, int]] = set(self.snake.body)
+            self.food.spawn(exclude)
+
+    def draw(self) -> None:
+        # Background
+        self.screen.fill(COLOR_BG)
+        # HUD area
+        # Draw score
+        score_surf = self.font_score.render(f"Score: {self.score}", True, COLOR_HUD_TEXT)
+        score_rect = score_surf.get_rect(midtop=(WIDTH // 2, 8))
+        self.screen.blit(score_surf, score_rect)
+
+        # Draw controls below score
+        controls_text = "Controls: Arrow keys - move    R - restart    Esc - quit"
+        ctrl_surf = self.font_controls.render(controls_text, True, COLOR_HUD_TEXT)
+        ctrl_rect = ctrl_surf.get_rect(midtop=(WIDTH // 2, 44))
+        self.screen.blit(ctrl_surf, ctrl_rect)
+
+        # Draw grid area
+        grid_top = HUD_HEIGHT
+        # draw grid lines
+        for x in range(GRID_SIZE + 1):
+            px = x * CELL_SIZE
+            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLOR_GRID, (px, grid_top), (px, grid_top + GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE))
+        for y in range(GRID_SIZE + 1):
+            py = grid_top + y * CELL_SIZE
+            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLOR_GRID, (0, py), (GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE, py))
+
+        # Draw food
+        fx, fy = grid_to_pixels(self.food.get_pos())
+        food_rect = pygame.Rect(fx + 1, fy + 1, CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLOR_FOOD, food_rect)
+
+        # Draw snake
+        for segment in self.snake.body:
+            sx, sy = grid_to_pixels(segment)
+            seg_rect = pygame.Rect(sx + 1, sy + 1, CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2)
+            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLOR_SNAKE, seg_rect)
+
+        # If game over, display message
+        if self.game_over:
+            go_surf = self.font_score.render(f"GAME OVER - Final Score: {self.score}", True, COLOR_GAME_OVER)
+            go_rect = go_surf.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, HUD_HEIGHT + (GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE) // 2))
+            self.screen.blit(go_surf, go_rect)
+
+    def run(self) -> None:
+        while self.running:
+            for event in pygame.event.get():
+                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
+                    print("QUIT", flush=True)
+                    self.running = False
+                elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
+                    self.handle_key(event.key)
+
+            # Update game state
+            self.update()
+
+            # Draw everything
+            self.draw()
+            pygame.display.flip()
+
+            # Cap the frame rate
+            self.clock.tick(FPS)
+
+        pygame.quit()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    Game().run()

Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - 0 (20x20 grid) -> game/snake_game.py (rendering) and game/constants.py (GRID_SIZE)
  - 1 (starting snake 3 squares centre) -> game/snake.py (Snake initial state) and snake_game.py (initialization)
  - 2 (move right steady) -> game/snake.py (move) and snake_game.py (timing loop, FPS)
  - 3 (arrow keys change dir) -> snake_game.py -> calls Snake.change_direction(dir)
  - 4 (cannot reverse) -> snake.py (change_direction guards)
  - 5 (food random empty) -> game/food.py (spawn) and snake_game.py (exclude positions)
  - 6 (eating grows) -> snake.py (grow flag) and snake_game.py (detect eat)
  - 7 (adds 1 point) -> snake_game.py (score update + console print)
  - 8 (spawn new food) -> food.py (spawn), snake_game.py (call spawn)
  - 9,10 (hitting wall/body ends) -> snake.py (collision helpers) and snake_game.py (game_over handling/display/print)
  - 11 (show score top) -> snake_game.py (HUD)
  - 12 (controls below score) -> snake_game.py (HUD, milestone 2)
  - 13 (print score on change) -> snake_game.py (print "SCORE:<n>")
  - 14,15 (GAME OVER display & print) -> snake_game.py (draw and print)
  - 16 (freeze snake on end) -> snake_game.py (stop calling move when game_over)
  - 17 (R restart) -> snake_game.py (reinitialize)
  - 18 (Escape quit) -> snake_game.py (handle QUIT)
  - 19 (plain coloured squares only) -> all drawing uses solid fills (snake, food)

- State ownership & interfaces:
  - Snake (game/snake.py)
    - Attributes: body (List[tuple[int,int]]), dir (tuple[int,int]), grow (bool)
    - Methods:
      - __init__(start_positions: list[tuple], start_dir: tuple) -> None
      - move() -> None
      - change_direction(new_dir: tuple[int,int]) -> None
      - head() -> tuple[int,int]
      - collides_with_self() -> bool
      - collides_with_wall(grid_w:int, grid_h:int) -> bool
      - grow_by_one() -> None
  - Food (game/food.py)
    - Attributes: pos (tuple[int,int]), grid_w, grid_h
    - Methods:
      - spawn(exclude: Set[tuple[int,int]]) -> None
      - get_pos() -> tuple[int,int]
  - Constants (game/constants.py): GRID_SIZE, CELL_SIZE, HUD_HEIGHT, WIDTH, HEIGHT, FPS, COLORS, DIRECTIONS

- Input -> action -> state -> feedback
  - KEYDOWN arrow -> snake_game.py maps to new_dir tuple -> snake.change_direction() -> modifies snake.dir if allowed -> prints "DIRECTION <name>" -> next frames snake.move() moves head by dir -> drawing shows snake moved.
  - Snake head == food pos -> snake.grow_by_one() -> increase score by 1, print "SCORE:<n>", food.spawn(exclude), continue.
  - Collision (wall or self) -> set game_over True, print "GAME OVER", stop moving snake, display "GAME OVER" and final score on screen until R pressed.
  - R -> reinitialize game state to fresh snake and score 0, print "RESTART".
  - Escape/QUIT event -> exit, print "QUIT".

- Coordinate convention:
  - Discrete grid coords (x: 0..GRID_SIZE-1, y: 0..GRID_SIZE-1).
  - Pixel position = (x * CELL_SIZE, HUD_HEIGHT + y * CELL_SIZE). Origin (0,0) top-left of window.
  - Head is snake.body[-1].

- Lifecycle:
  - init: pygame init, new_game() creates Snake and Food.
  - play: loop runs at FPS (10); on each frame if not game_over, snake.move(); check collisions and eating; render HUD, grid, snake, food.
  - terminal: game_over True freezes movement and waits for R or ESC.
  - reset: R calls new_game() restoring all state.

        self.font_score = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
        self.font_controls = pygame.font.Font(None, 24)

        self.new_game()

        mid_y = GRID_SIZE // 2
        # 3-length snake centered horizontally, head at the rightmost segment, moving right
        start_positions = [(mid_x - 1, mid_y), (mid_x, mid_y), (mid_x + 1, mid_y)]
        start_dir = DIRECTIONS['RIGHT']

            pygame.K_DOWN: 'DOWN',
            pygame.K_LEFT: 'LEFT',
            pygame.K_RIGHT: 'RIGHT',

            new_dir = DIRECTIONS[name]
            changed = self.snake.change_direction(new_dir)

                    self.running = False

        start_dir = DIRECTIONS['RIGHT']
        self.snake = Snake(start_positions, start_dir)
        self.food = Food(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE)
        # ensure food not on snake
        exclude = set(self.snake.body)
        self.food.spawn(exclude)
        self.score = 0
        self.game_over = False
        print("RESTART", flush=True)

    def handle_key(self, key) -> None:
        if key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            print("QUIT", flush=True)
            self.running = False
            return
        if key == pygame.K_r:
            self.new_game()
            return
        if self.game_over:
            # ignore direction changes while game over
            return
        # Arrow keys
        mapping = {
            pygame.K_UP: 'UP',
            pygame.K_DOWN: 'DOWN',
            pygame.K_LEFT: 'LEFT',
            pygame.K_RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
        }
        if key in mapping:
            name = mapping[key]
            new_dir = DIRECTIONS[name]
            changed = self.snake.change_direction(new_dir)
            if changed:
                print(f"DIRECTION {name}", flush=True)

    def update(self) -> None:
        if self.game_over:
            return
        # Move snake one cell per frame (FPS controls speed)
        self.snake.move()
        # Check collisions
        if self.snake.collides_with_wall(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE) or self.snake.collides_with_self():
            self.game_over = True
            print("GAME OVER", flush=True)
            return
        # Check eating
        if self.snake.head() == self.food.get_pos():
            self.snake.grow_by_one()
            self.score += 1
            print(f"SCORE:{self.score}", flush=True)
            # spawn new food excluding snake body
            exclude: Set[Tuple[int, int]] = set(self.snake.body)
            self.food.spawn(exclude)

    def draw(self) -> None:
        # Background
        self.screen.fill(COLOR_BG)
        # HUD area
        # Draw score
        score_surf = self.font_score.render(f"Score: {self.score}", True, COLOR_HUD_TEXT)
        score_rect = score_surf.get_rect(midtop=(WIDTH // 2, 8))
        self.screen.blit(score_surf, score_rect)

        # Draw controls below score
        controls_text = "Controls: Arrow keys - move    R - restart    Esc - quit"
        ctrl_surf = self.font_controls.render(controls_text, True, COLOR_HUD_TEXT)
        ctrl_rect = ctrl_surf.get_rect(midtop=(WIDTH // 2, 44))
        self.screen.blit(ctrl_surf, ctrl_rect)

        # Draw grid area
        grid_top = HUD_HEIGHT
        # draw grid lines
        for x in range(GRID_SIZE + 1):
            px = x * CELL_SIZE
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLOR_GRID, (px, grid_top), (px, grid_top + GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE))
        for y in range(GRID_SIZE + 1):
            py = grid_top + y * CELL_SIZE
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen, COLOR_GRID, (0, py), (GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE, py))

        # Draw food
        fx, fy = grid_to_pixels(self.food.get_pos())
        food_rect = pygame.Rect(fx + 1, fy + 1, CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLOR_FOOD, food_rect)

        # Draw snake
        for segment in self.snake.body:
            sx, sy = grid_to_pixels(segment)
            seg_rect = pygame.Rect(sx + 1, sy + 1, CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2)
            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, COLOR_SNAKE, seg_rect)

        # If game over, display message
        if self.game_over:
            go_surf = self.font_score.render(f"GAME OVER - Final Score: {self.score}", True, COLOR_GAME_OVER)
            go_rect = go_surf.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, HUD_HEIGHT + (GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE) // 2))
            self.screen.blit(go_surf, go_rect)

    def run(self) -> None:
        while self.running:
            for event in pygame.event.get():
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    print("QUIT", flush=True)
                    self.running = False
                elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                    self.handle_key(event.key)

            # Update game state
            self.update()

            # Draw everything
            self.draw()
            pygame.display.flip()

            # Cap the frame rate
            self.clock.tick(FPS)

        pygame.quit()
